name: OpenApps API
description: Read-only and public. Every answer is { data, meta }; meta.basis says what each value is (observed, store_reported, derived, proxy). Links in rows point at https://theopenapps.com. x-openapps-cache: an answer stands until new data lands (data), an MCP server's tools change (data_or_tools) or the UTC day ends (day). Agents: https://theopenapps.com/v1/agent-context, MCP at https://theopenapps.com/mcp.
